parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p),
q AS (SELECT value AS quote FROM payload, jsonb_array_elements_text(p->'quotes') AS value),
qc AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('quote', quote, 'found', EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM session s WHERE s.transcript ILIKE '%' || quote || '%'
    UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM clip c WHERE c.text ILIKE '%' || quote || '%'
    UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM gong_calls g WHERE g.data::text ILIKE '%' || quote || '%'
    UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM forum f WHERE f.content ILIKE '%' || quote || '%'
  ))), '[]'::jsonb) AS quote_checks FROM q
),
sids AS (SELECT DISTINCT (value)::uuid AS sid FROM payload, jsonb_array_elements_text(p->'sids') AS value),
tx AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(sid::text, jsonb_build_object('words', words, 'starts', starts)), '{}'::jsonb) AS transcripts
  FROM (
    SELECT ss.id AS sid,
           array_agg(lower(regexp_replace((e->>'word'), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) ORDER BY ord) AS words,
           array_agg((e->>'start')::float8 ORDER BY ord) AS starts
    FROM sids JOIN session ss ON ss.id = sids.sid
    CROSS JOIN unnest(ss.transcript_object) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(e, ord)
    GROUP BY ss.id
  ) z
)
SELECT qc.quote_checks, tx.transcripts FROM qc, tx

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ JSON.stringify({ faithfulness: $json.faithfulness, citation_validity: $json.citation_validity, source_routing: $json.source_routing, completeness: $json.completeness, relevance: $json.relevance, format: $json.format, verdict: $json.verdict }) }}
